_doc: Opt-in 820 reading diagnostic (R-tablet-reading-baseline). Not part of rsi/runtime/ux/journeys.json: its expected RED records the four Open gap-log findings of 2026-11-21, so it must not enter the default gate until the coherent reading fix makes it green. It boots the same throwaway daemon and fake agent through scripts/journeys-smoke.sh --spec. The answer is the fake's `[seed] reading` branch: a long prose answer with a 5-row markdown table. The new-activity state is produced by sending a `[seed] slow` follow-up, scrolling back to the top while it is held, and then letting the reply land out of sight. `reading` observes only: metrics go to <out>/*.reading.json and the shared verdict names each criterion separately. 390 is not a reference: its header is MobileHeader (a different control set), so the desktop action-cluster metric does not apply there; 1100 is walked as the same-metric reference.
